description: This file contains generic helper functions for JavaScript, including string padding, cross-browser XMLHttpRequest creation, CSS rule insertion, legacy browser support, and filename unquoting/unescaping.

methods.name: padLeftStr
methods.description: Pads the input on the left with a specified string to reach a given width.

methods.name: padLeft
methods.description: Pads the input on the left with a specified character to reach a given width.

methods.name: addCssRule
methods.description: Inserts a CSS rule into the first stylesheet for a given selector.

methods.name: unquote
methods.description: Unquotes and unescapes a filename string, handling C-style escape sequences.
